createRoot: react-dom/client: makes the root a React app renders into
event: suss: sub-unit kind for a JSX event handler
forwardRef: react: wraps a component and hands back the component it was given
hydrate: react-dom: React 17's call that attaches an element to server-rendered markup
memo: react: wraps a component and hands back the component it was given
n: the second character of the `on` prefix React event props carry
o: the leading character of the `on` prefix React event props carry
useCallback: react: the hook that hands back the callback it was given
